en.headline: MPF full portability first phase starts 21 December, covering about one million employees
en.dek: The Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority says employees who joined or changed jobs after 1 May 2025 can transfer employer contributions once a calendar year from that date.
body: The first phase of Mandatory Provident Fund full portability will begin on 21 December, covering about one million employees who joined the workforce or changed jobs on or after 1 May 2025, the authority said.

Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority chairwoman Ayesha Macpherson Lau said in a blog post that eligible employees may transfer the full amount of employer mandatory contributions accumulated in their current job from the employer’s scheme contribution account to a personal account in a scheme of their choice, once per calendar year.

She noted that the eMPF platform has been updated to support the transfers. Employees can make the 2026 transfer between 21 and 31 December or wait until 2027. Lau advised against transferring merely for the sake of it and urged careful comparison of funds, performance and fees according to personal circumstances.

The second phase, for those already in their current jobs before 1 May 2025, requires further legislative amendments because some employer contributions may still be used for offsetting. The government is expected to submit the relevant bill to the Legislative Council around mid-2027.

zh.headline: 強積金全自由行首階段12月21日實施 涵蓋約100萬僱員
zh.dek: 積金局主席劉麥嘉軒表示，2025年5月1日或之後入職或轉職的僱員，可由該日起每個公曆年一次轉移僱主強制性供款的全數累算權益。
body: 強制性公積金「全自由行」首階段將於12月21日推出，涵蓋約100萬名於2025年5月1日或之後加入職場或曾轉職的僱員。
積金局主席劉麥嘉軒在網誌表示，合資格僱員可於每個公曆年一次，將現職期間由僱主強制性供款所產生的強積金，全數從僱主參加的強積金計劃下的供款帳戶，轉移至自選的強積金計劃下的個人帳戶。
她指出，「積金易」平台已更新相應功能，僱員可在今年12月21日至31日辦理2026年的轉移，亦可在明年1月1日起辦理2027年的轉移。劉麥嘉軒提醒切忌「為轉而轉」，應比較不同計劃的基金選擇、表現及收費，並按個人情況審慎決定。
至於次階段，涉及2025年5月1日前已開始現職的僱員，因部分僱主供款仍可能用於對沖，需額外修例，政府料於2027年中向立法會提交相關條例草案。
